create_clevr_distance_dataset: create a classification dataset from CLEVR images by estimating the closest object distance
download_clevr_dataset: download and extract the CLEVR_v1.0 dataset archive to a specified root directory
run_clevr_dist_script: run the CLEVR distance data creation script with input and output paths via argparse CLI
get_clevr_argument_parser: get an argparse argument parser for the CLEVR distance dataset creation script
build_clevr_disk_folder: build a disk folder format dataset from CLEVR scenes with distance-based classification labels
